title: GDHCN Trust Network — Personal Health Wallet Upstream Normative Specifications Catalogue
sizeBasis: Measured 2026-10-30 from the two materialized IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Framework supplements governing patient privacy consent and verifiable health link workflows in smart-trust-phw: IHE ITI Privacy Consent on FHIR (PCF) v1.1.0 (`ihe-iti-pcf-1-1-0`) and IHE ITI Verifiable Health Links (VHL) v1.0.0-comment (`ihe-iti-vhl-1-0-0-comment`). Bean sl5v. Since bean folio-assistant-djj5 (2026-11-03) the catalogue also holds the 5 works the IG cites that are not ingested, as `referenced` items with no bytes held; `totalFilesUpstream` and `totalBytesUpstream` still count only the two materialized supplements.

sourceLoss.container: LOST WITH THE SOURCE. A container node holds only a title and upstream URL.
sourceLoss.referencedItem: METADATA SURVIVES, BYTES DO NOT. A referenced item keeps its node and its folio-dublin-core/v1 record; a cited work's capture is recorded in `uploads/<slug>/intake.json`.
sourceLoss.materializedItem: THE ARCHIVAL COPY SURVIVES. A materialized item's bytes are held in `library/` with a recorded sha256 verified by `check:materialized-fixity`, alongside its qualified Dublin Core (`folio-dublin-core/v1`) record and CC BY 4.0 licence record.
